title: 25th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/25/2024).
Approval of the minutes of three previous sittings (minutes Nos. 19/2024 to 21/2024).
Unfinished business: continued debate on the Insurance Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Mahibadhoo MP Ahmed Thoriq.
Report of the Decentralisation Committee on its review of the Bill amending the Decentralisation Act (Law No. 7/2010).
Report of the Decentralisation Committee on its review of the Bill amending the Local Council Elections Act (Law No. 10/2010).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting approved old minutes, continued the Insurance Bill debate and took up committee reports on the decentralisation and local council election amendment bills.
